description:
A diner manager needs to set up the POS system so cashiers can capture how customers want their burgers cooked. Using the Floreant POS Back Office (PIN: 1111), create a new modifier group named 'Cooking Temperature' with exactly five modifiers, each with an extra price of $0.00:

1. Rare
2. Medium Rare
3. Medium
4. Medium Well
5. Well Done

Starting from the main terminal screen, click BACK OFFICE, enter PIN 1111, navigate to the modifier management area (Explorers > Modifiers), create the group, add all five modifiers, and save your changes.
